lines.say: Not sore after the gym? Does that mean the workout didn't work?
Nope. Soreness is a terrible way to measure growth.
That ache, one to three days later, comes from tiny damage and swelling in muscle that isn't used to the work.
But do the same workout again, and your muscle adapts fast. Much less soreness next time.
Scientists call this the repeated bout effect.
Your muscle still grows. It just stops complaining.
Growth comes from tension: lifting heavy, close to failure, and adding a little more over time.
So stop chasing soreness. Chase progress.
